positions.title: Concrete Finisher
positions.text: Place and finish slabs, curb and structural concrete on commercial, industrial and municipal projects.
duties: Screed, float, edge and trowel concrete
Run power trowels and screeds
Apply broom and smooth trowel finishes
Cure, cut joints and seal
reqs: Able to work outdoors in all seasons

positions.title: Form Setter / Carpenter
positions.text: Set, align, brace and strip forms for footings, foundation walls and retaining walls.
duties: Read plans and lay out footings and walls
Set and brace aluminum and wood forms
Place rebar, anchor bolts and embeds
Strip, clean and load forms
reqs: Comfortable with layout tools and levels

positions.title: Equipment Operator
positions.text: Operate excavators, skid steers and loaders for excavation, grading and backfill.
duties: Excavate footings and basements to grade
Grade and compact base material
Backfill foundations carefully
Perform daily equipment checks
reqs: Ability to read grade stakes and plans

positions.title: Construction Laborer
positions.text: Support our crews on every phase of concrete construction. No experience required — we will train you.
duties: Prepare sites, move materials and tools
Assist with forming, pouring and finishing
Keep job sites clean and organized

positions.title: CDL Driver (Class A/B)
positions.text: Haul equipment, forms and materials between our yard and job sites.
duties: Transport equipment and materials safely
Load, secure and unload trailers
Complete pre-trip inspections and logs
reqs: Valid Class A or B CDL

positions.title: Foreman / Crew Lead
positions.text: Lead a crew to deliver safe, high-quality, on-schedule concrete work.
duties: Run daily crew operations and safety briefings
Coordinate with builders, GCs and inspectors
Plan pours, order materials and track progress

benefits.title: Competitive pay
benefits.text: Wages that reward skill and experience, with regular reviews.

benefits.title: Health benefits
benefits.text: Medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time employees.

benefits.title: Paid time off
benefits.text: Paid holidays and PTO, because time away matters.

benefits.title: 401(k) retirement
benefits.text: Plan for the future with a company retirement plan.

benefits.title: Training & growth
benefits.text: Learn new skills, earn certifications and move into leadership.

benefits.title: Year-round work
benefits.text: Cold-weather capability keeps our crews working through winter.
